statement.ko: \(x=4000\ \mathrm{ft},\quad h=3000\ \mathrm{ft},\quad\dot h=600\ \mathrm{ft/s}\) 카메라는 수직 상승 로켓의 발사대에서 수평 사천 피트 떨어져 있다. (a) 로켓까지 거리와 (b) 고도각의 변화율을 구하라.
statement.en: \(x=4000\ \mathrm{ft},\quad h=3000\ \mathrm{ft},\quad\dot h=600\ \mathrm{ft/s}\) A camera tracks a vertically rising rocket from 4000 ft horizontally away. Find rates of (a) camera-to-rocket distance and (b) elevation angle.

statement.en: \(d=3\ \mathrm{km},\quad\dot\theta=4\ \mathrm{rev/min},\quad x=1\ \mathrm{km}\) A lighthouse is 3 km from the nearest shore point P. Find the spot’s speed along the straight shore at distance 1 km from P.
